title: Tortillas de Masa Fresca (Fresh Masa Tortillas)
origin: Migrated from Oaxaca Casa Crespo/Tortillas de masa fresca.doc (file dated 2024-03-07)

items: Comal, ungreased cast iron, or nonstick skillet

steps.action: Work with water until elastic and moist; divide into 12 balls (40 g each):
Press each ball between two 20 cm (8 in) plastic sheets in a tortilla press:
items: More pressure, thinner tortilla; target about 14 cm (5½ in)
Peel the top sheet, flip onto your palm, peel the second sheet
Lay on the comal; when edges dry (about 10 sec), flip
Cook about 1 min, flip again, 15 sec more
